name: Glanzer's "Pick Your Own" Pumpkin Patch
description: Glanzer's "Pick Your Own" Pumpkin Patch is an pumpkin patch in 258 Hwy 27 W, MN. Visitors come for Apples, Pumpkins, Squash, Corn, and Honey, best in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
